posts.subject: Look...
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello Dear Dream Community,


I wanted to say that in the past I did not have the best days yes I did do wrong and I admit to this but how the bullying and attack on me sometimes by players carry on is not very nice, I don't want to tell people to stop as I'm more of a shy person and talking to a big part of people in a knife server would be too stressful and would not probably change anything that's why I created this post so people would finally understand that making fun or directing insults at me is not fun and it's mostly makes me kinda sad, I'm nice and easy to talk to and can have fun with people but when people target me soo many times it's just upsetting and unkind, put yourself in my spot and ask yourself "Would I like this to happen to me?" the answer would probably be "No" so guys pleas respect that I'm trying and insulting would not help.


Kind Regards


Michal "OxygeN" J.

@OxygeN I can really agree on this, seen it myself. When you started to be a admin again and you joined the server as a admin, most of the players just gave you shit cause they tought that you would do the same mistake again. How I know they did? I was there and was I on the bad side? Absolutely not, I told everyone to stop hating on you Michal and giving you shit. I really don't think the know you as a person, just the guy who as more "power" than everone else and you made one little mistake and that you are a bad person. You are a respected and nice person to talk to and I think that everyone giving shit should first know who you really are cause you don't judge a book on it's fucking cover! [^^]

Very brave of you to come out and say this Oxygen.


However, not trying to be rude or being the 'special' one and having a non-sympathetic opinion, but I'm going to more of a realist's point of view. Okay, true, you might've changed and you are no longer the Oxygen that we used to know but nevertheless, you still can't blame the community that much. Sounds harsh but, the truth is, they will always think the same of you unless you change their minds. What I mean is that, very well, you may have changed but how do they know you've changed? What have you done to make them believe that you are more than just an admin?


My suggestion is, instead of hiding away and doing other stuff, go and play more regularly on the servers (I've seen you just 'online' very often) and try to help the community. I'm not saying, go to the knife server and ban every single slight rule breaker you see, but generally keep order in the server while letting players have their fun (I can tell you that one of the reasons some players dislike you being admin is because you are too strict and often very enforcing).


Lastly, you need to change that opinion on yourself too. Tbh, you just need to stop thinking that they hate you and that they still judge you and focus on the fact that actually - okay, I've changed, now I'm going to show them I've changed.



Good luck,
~Doo Doo


P.S. One of the key ways as to how to be a well respected admin, in my opinion, is to make the server fun. Do more gamemodes with the players: Introducing the 35hp knife gamemodes! .

@WHAT/WAIT/WHERE Thanks for this appreciate it.


@Doo Doo Thanks for being honest with me and I will take into consideration what you said especially doing gamemodes that you listed in the separate topic this will be pretty fun for the community, I was not doing them because I thought I will not be able to handle such a big gamemode with alot of players.


You will be able to see me alot more often on the server now.

I don't know you and we haven't played yet but why would you take any kind of harassment or bullying serious? You're in the Internet man of course people are rude. Don't want to offend you, just a curious question

It is nice ti see that behind oxygen nick is real person 😄 I am not saying that you have been acting like it's not, cause since I know you you have always been such a nice guy and that is why I am surprised that somebody can be rude to you... Be strong and stick to you friends. Like me [;-)]
